description: This file is a Java Spring MVC controller class that manages merchant store operations in an e-commerce admin panel, including listing, creating, editing, saving, and removing stores.

classes.name: MerchantStoreController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that handles HTTP requests related to merchant store management in the admin interface, including listing, creation, editing, validation, and deletion of stores.

methods.name: displayStores
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of merchant stores, setting up the menu and returning the view for store listing.

methods.name: pageStores
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch a paginated list of stores in JSON format, excluding the default store.

methods.name: displayMerchantStoreCreate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store creation form with pre-filled session store data.

methods.name: displayMerchantStore
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store details for viewing or editing.

methods.name: saveMerchantStore
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update store details, including validation, setting related entities, and sending notification emails upon creation.

methods.name: checkStoreCode
methods.description: Handles POST requests to verify if a store code already exists, returning JSON response.

methods.name: removeMerchantStore
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a merchant store, with security check for superadmin privileges.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for the views to display the correct active menu items.
